experiment.claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's ratified "PSRR" row (>50dB @ 1kHz and >20dB @ 100kHz, at 1mA (light-load, binding) and at 50mA) against the LDO core-regulation-loop schematic (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch). The row is ratified by issue #1 / DR-006, and the four bounds below cite it verbatim. As of #117 this deck measures all FOUR conditions the row names -- both frequencies at BOTH load points. The v1 deck measured only the ~1mA point because the pre-#25 five-transistor amplifier had no valid regulating DC operating point at 50mA to linearize around; #25's current-mirror-OTA rebuild removed that ceiling, and the 50mA point now regulates (VOUT = 1.798V at tt/27C/3.30V), so the row's 50mA half is no longer un-testbenched. Both load points are swept inside one deck (the 1.8kOhm schematic load, then 'alter rload = 36'), the same single-deck/multi-point pattern sim/loop-gain uses.
